data.title: 雷姆 · 烘焙坊
data.description: 清晨的街角面包店里，雷姆穿浅蓝麻花针织开衫、象牙白圆领上衣与藏蓝百褶中裙，白蕾丝发饰仍留在短蓝发上。面包篮挂在左前臂，她右手持夹子把一根法棍从木展示架上夹起，准备放入篮里。近处牛皮纸衬垫和篮条清楚可见；身后两层木架分放圆面包与可颂，柜台尽头留出通向烤炉的过道。右侧晨光照亮金黄面包皮和她的手指，夹子与篮条在纸面留下细影，架层之间有较深暗部——「今天的早餐就选这个吧。昴君一定也会喜欢刚出炉的面包。」
data.location: 街角面包店木展示架前，柜台尽头过道连向烤炉
data.action: 左前臂挂面包篮，右手持夹子夹起一根法棍，准备放进篮中。
data.lighting: morning window light from the right on bread crusts and fingers; shelf gaps in shade
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, tongs, baguette, supported basket and bread shelves visible
data.promptProse: Fresh baguette crust catches the morning light as Rem lifts one loaf with the tongs in her right hand. A bread basket hangs securely from her left forearm, ready below the loaf. She wears a powder-blue cable-knit cardigan, an ivory blouse with a rounded collar and a navy pleated skirt; the white lace headdress remains above her short blue hair. Woven basket strips and its kraft-paper lining fill the near foreground. Behind her, two wooden shelf tiers separate round loaves from croissants, and a clear passage at the counter's end leads toward the bakery oven. Keep hand, tongs, loaf and basket connections legible in an eye-level medium portrait. Sun from the right window warms the crust and her fingers, with fine tong and basket shadows on the paper. Deeper shelf gaps separate the bread rows.
